missions.title: First Measurement
missions.description: Complete 3 basic pip measurement challenges in the Pip Academy or Measurement Lab.

dialogue.offered: Welcome to Pip District, initiate! Every price fluctuation on a currency pair is measured in pips. Visit the Pip Academy or Price Ladder and accurately measure 3 price movements.
dialogue.in_progress: You're learning how price distance is calculated. Continue measuring pip movements in the Academy or Price Ladder until you reach 3.
dialogue.ready_to_claim: Outstanding accuracy! You have proven you can calculate price movement in standard 4-decimal format. Claim your World XP!
dialogue.completed: You have mastered the foundational First Measurement directive. Talk to Precision Instructor next for non-standard formats.

missions.title: Precision Test
missions.description: Correctly solve 10 pip movement questions across training drills and Pip Blitz Arena matches.

dialogue.offered: Precision requires consistency under market pressure. Correctly solve 10 pip calculation questions across our drills or Pip Blitz matches.
dialogue.in_progress: Stay focused! Pay close attention to direction (bullish vs bearish) and the fourth decimal place. Reach 10 correct solutions.
dialogue.ready_to_claim: Target achieved! 10 accurate pip calculations verified. Your measurement instincts are getting sharp.
dialogue.completed: 10 confirmed solutions logged! You're ready to tackle currency pairs with different decimal conventions.

missions.title: JPY Zone
missions.description: Complete the JPY Precision Zone challenge to master 2-decimal and 3-decimal pricing conventions.

dialogue.offered: Traders who treat USD/JPY like EUR/USD suffer heavy losses! Japanese Yen pairs quote 1 pip at the 2nd decimal place (0.01). Step into the JPY Precision Zone and complete the challenge.
dialogue.in_progress: The JPY Precision Zone is in the Precision Lab. Practice measuring 150.20 -> 150.30 (10 pips) and finish the session.
dialogue.ready_to_claim: Superb work! You now instinctively identify the pip place on Yen crosses. Claim your specialist commendation.
dialogue.completed: You know your JPY quoting conventions. Always remember the 0.01 pip rule when trading Yen pairs.

missions.title: Fractional Precision
missions.description: Complete 5 pipette/fractional pip challenges (1 pipette = 0.1 pip = 1 point).

dialogue.offered: Modern electronic brokers quote 5 decimal places (and 3 for JPY). The 5th digit is a pipette (0.1 pip or 1 point). Complete 5 fractional pip exercises in the Precision Lab.
dialogue.in_progress: Keep practicing: 1.10520 to 1.10527 is 7 points (0.7 pips). Complete 5 fractional calculations.
dialogue.ready_to_claim: Fractional precision confirmed! You can convert points and fractional pipettes seamlessly. Claim your reward.
dialogue.completed: You've mastered fractional quoting. You'll never get confused between points and full pips.

missions.title: Know Your Instrument
missions.description: Complete the Instrument Rules Lab to understand tick sizes, point conventions, and market-specific increments.

dialogue.offered: Forex pairs, commodities like Gold (XAU/USD), and indices like US30 use different tick values and point rules. Visit the Instrument Rules section in the Precision Lab to learn these critical differences.
dialogue.in_progress: Explore the Instrument Rules terminal in the Precision Lab. Learn why one universal rule cannot be blindly applied to all financial assets.
dialogue.ready_to_claim: Excellent! You now understand contract specifications and tick sizes across major asset classes.
dialogue.completed: Always check your broker's contract specs before placing an order on an unfamiliar instrument.

missions.title: Risk Engineer
missions.description: Complete 3 simulated lot-sizing scenarios in the Risk & Position Forge.

dialogue.offered: Capital preservation is the only law of professional trading. Enter the Risk & Position Forge. Calculate correct lot sizing based on 1-2% account risk and stop-loss distance across 3 scenarios.
dialogue.in_progress: Head to the Risk & Position Forge in the east wing. Solve 3 sizing scenarios using the formula: Position Size = (Account × Risk%) / (Stop Pips × Pip Value).
dialogue.ready_to_claim: Flawless mathematical discipline! You sized your position to protect capital, not to gamble. Claim your reward!
dialogue.completed: Position sizing is your primary defense shield. Never risk more than your pre-defined percentage.

missions.title: Leverage Check
missions.description: Complete the interactive Leverage Tower simulation to observe margin requirements and exposure changes.

dialogue.offered: Leverage is a double-edged sword. It amplifies both purchasing power and the speed of capital destruction. Ascend the Leverage Tower and simulate margin requirements under 1:10, 1:50, and 1:100 leverage.
dialogue.in_progress: Enter the Leverage Tower at the north end of Pip Plaza. Adjust balance and leverage parameters to observe required margin and liquidation risk.
dialogue.ready_to_claim: Tower trial completed! You now clearly understand the difference between purchasing exposure and margin safety.
dialogue.completed: Leverage is a tool for capital efficiency, not an excuse to overtrade. Keep your risk strictly controlled.

missions.title: Pip Blitz
missions.description: Complete one full 10-round match in the Pip Blitz Arena under countdown pressure.

dialogue.offered: Put your measurement reflexes to the test! Step into the Pip Blitz Arena in the northeast sector and complete a 10-round procedural match.
dialogue.in_progress: The Pip Blitz Arena is waiting. Clear all 10 rounds of Measure, Direction, Speed, and Matching targets.
dialogue.ready_to_claim: Match finished! You maintained rapid precision through all 10 procedural rounds. Take your well-earned reward!
dialogue.completed: Blitz match logged! Replay anytime to push your combo multiplier and Pip Mastery to 100%.

missions.title: City Explorer
missions.description: Physically navigate Pip District and interact with 6 unique facilities, labs, and terminals.

dialogue.offered: Get familiar with our precision metropolis! Visit Pip Academy, Precision Lab, Leverage Tower, Risk & Position Forge, Risk Arena, and Mission HQ.
dialogue.in_progress: Walk the avenues of Pip District! Check in at all major learning facilities and arenas to map out the district.
dialogue.ready_to_claim: District mapped! You have explored every corner of Pip District. Claim your Pioneer commendation.
dialogue.completed: You know the entire district layout. Use each facility regularly to hone your precision math.

missions.title: Precision Master
missions.description: Complete the advanced precision and position sizing trial to prove comprehensive market measurement mastery.

dialogue.offered: This is the final trial of Pip District. You must combine pip distance calculation, JPY quoting, fractional pipettes, and position lot sizing in a comprehensive multi-step trial.
dialogue.in_progress: Visit the Pip Mentor terminal in Pip Plaza or the Risk Arena to execute the full Precision Master trial.
dialogue.ready_to_claim: Mastery trial passed with flying colors! You have conquered the mathematics of price movement and risk control.
dialogue.completed: You are an officially certified Precision Master of Strativo World. Wear your title with pride!
